purpose: Teach: マッチ/アホ/佐々木/岐阜/さぁ/たまる/珠/うめ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お料理のマッチングが大事よ
lines.en: Sho, you know — when food and people match well, it makes everything better.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful voice with a slight pause before the insight. Speaking as if Mei is working through an idea aloud. Warm and maternal, but not condescending. She's speaking to a child who listens carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「アホ」って怒られちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, my dad got mad at me and called me stupid.
lines.style: Small, quiet voice with a catch of hurt underneath. Not dramatic — just stating a fact that stung. Quick intake of breath before the last word, like he's reliving the moment. Eyes downward.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、佐々木先生は優しい人ね
lines.en: Sho, Sasaki-sensei is a kind person, isn't he?
lines.style: Reassuring tone, steady and warm. She's offering this gently, as a corrective thought — not dismissing what happened, but reminding him of something true. Slight tilt of her head, like she's seeing him clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、岐阜のお祖父ちゃんちに行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to Grandpa's house in Gifu.
lines.style: Brightening suddenly, the earlier hurt breaking. Genuine want in the voice — excited but still small, still respectful. Ending on a slight upturn, like he's asking permission or checking if it's okay to want this.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、さぁ、お遊びの時間よ
lines.style: Shift into something brighter and more active. A gentle but purposeful redirect. The warmth is still there, but there's an intention behind it — she's moving him forward, away from the hurt. Clear, decisive, kind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの貯金箱、お金がたまる音がするよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my piggy bank — you can hear the coins landing in it.
lines.style: Wonder in the voice. He's noticed something small and delighted by it. Speaking with genuine pleasure, almost to himself, but wanting to share it with her. Small and present, not reaching.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんのお首飾り、珠でできてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother's necklace is made of pearls, you see.
lines.style: Reflective and gentle, as if she's showing him something beautiful. Speaking slowly enough for him to follow the image. There's a tender quality — she's helping him see something lovely in what's familiar. Soft trailing at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うめぼし、美味しいよね。メイ姉さん、ぼく、お庭の梅、見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, pickled plums taste good — I saw the plum tree in the garden.
lines.style: Linking two small joys together. His voice is warm and present, sharing something he noticed. Natural, unburdened — the earlier hurt has lightened. Direct eye contact implied, speaking with easy affection to someone safe.
